title.en: Find the mean by the direct, assumed mean and step deviation methods

say.en: Your parents ask, "How did your class do in economics?" You can't read out 60 marks. You need one number that represents them all. In this lesson: Define central tendency.
Find the mean by the direct, assumed mean and step deviation methods.

title.en: Central tendency and the arithmetic mean

body.en: A measure of *central tendency* is a single value that represents a whole set of data. The arithmetic mean is the sum of all observations divided by their number: $\bar{X} = \frac{\sum X}{N}$. The sum of deviations from the mean is always zero.
body.kn: ಇಡೀ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿನಿಧಿಸುವ ಒಂದು ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿಯ ಅಳತೆ. ಅಂಕಗಣಿತ ಸರಾಸರಿ = ಎಲ್ಲ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತ ÷ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ. ಸರಾಸರಿಯಿಂದ ವಿಚಲನಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತ ಶೂನ್ಯ.

title.en: Assumed mean and step deviation methods

body.en: To save work, assume a mean A, take *deviations* $d = X - A$, and use $\bar{X} = A + \frac{\sum d}{N}$. If the deviations share a common factor c, divide by it: $d' = (X - A)/c$ and $\bar{X} = A + \frac{\sum d'}{N} \times c$.
body.kn: ಕೆಲಸ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡಲು ಊಹಿತ ಸರಾಸರಿ A ತೆಗೆದು ವಿಚಲನ ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯಿರಿ. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಅಂಶ c ಇದ್ದರೆ ಅದರಿಂದ ಭಾಗಿಸಿ, ಕೊನೆಗೆ c ಯಿಂದ ಗುಣಿಸಿ. ಇದು ಹಂತ ವಿಚಲನ ವಿಧಾನ.

narration.en: To save work, assume a mean A and take deviations from it. The mean is A plus the sum of deviations divided by N. If the deviations share a common factor c, divide them by c, and multiply back by c at the end. This is the step deviation method.
narration.kn: ಕೆಲಸ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡಲು ಊಹಿತ ಸರಾಸರಿ A ತೆಗೆದು ವಿಚಲನ ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯಿರಿ. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಅಂಶ c ಇದ್ದರೆ ಅದರಿಂದ ಭಾಗಿಸಿ, ಕೊನೆಗೆ c ಯಿಂದ ಗುಣಿಸಿ. ಇದು ಹಂತ ವಿಚಲನ ವಿಧಾನ.

say.en: To save work, assume a mean A and take deviations from it. The mean is A plus the sum of deviations divided by N. If the deviations share a common factor c, divide them by c, and multiply back by c at the end. This is the step deviation method. Assumed mean: X̄ = A plus Σd/N.
say.kn: ಕೆಲಸ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡಲು ಊಹಿತ ಸರಾಸರಿ A ತೆಗೆದು ವಿಚಲನ ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯಿರಿ. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಅಂಶ c ಇದ್ದರೆ ಅದರಿಂದ ಭಾಗಿಸಿ, ಕೊನೆಗೆ c ಯಿಂದ ಗುಣಿಸಿ. ಇದು ಹಂತ ವಿಚಲನ ವಿಧಾನ.

say.en: Step deviation: X̄ = A plus (Σd′/N) times c.

problem.en: Find the mean of 40, 50, 55, 78, 58 by the direct and assumed mean (A = 55) methods.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Find the mean of 40, 50, 55, 78, 58 by the direct and assumed mean (A = 55) methods.

say.en: Let us work this out together. Find the mean of 40, 50, 55, 78, 58 by the direct and assumed mean A equals 55 methods.
Direct: ΣX equals 40 plus 50 plus 55 plus 78 plus 58 equals 281; X̄ = 281 divided by 5 equals 56.2.
Assumed mean: d equals X minus 55 equals minus 15, minus 5, 0, 23, 3; Σd equals 6.
X̄ = 55 plus 6 over 5 equals 55 plus 1.2 equals 56.2. Both methods agree.
So the answer is 56.2.

problem.en: Find the mean of 100, 150, 200, 250, 300 by the step deviation method (A = 200, c = 50).

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Find the mean of 100, 150, 200, 250, 300 by the step deviation method (A = 200, c = 50).

say.en: Let us work this out together. Find the mean of 100, 150, 200, 250, 300 by the step deviation method (A equals 200, c equals 50).
d′ = X minus 200 divided by 50 equals minus 2, minus 1, 0, 1, 2.
X̄ = 200 plus (0 over 5) times 50 equals 200.
So the answer is 200.
